severity_name: HEAVY SLOP WARNING — EMOTIONAL EXPLOITATION ADVISORY
headline: HEAVY SLOP WARNING: SYMPATHY-BAIT FRONT SATURATES THE FACEBOOK DELTA AS FABRICATED LONELY BIRTHDAYS, WEEPING VETERANS, AND UNADMIRED HANDMADE CAKES DEMAND ENGAGEMENT NO REAL PERSON EVER REQUESTED
advisory: A dense, slow-moving system of manufactured pathos is drawing warm engagement across the lower Delta, where synthetic images of tearful figures, sagging homemade cakes, and hand-lettered signs reading 'nobody said happy birthday' are farming reflexive kindness at industrial scale. Residents are advised that the emotions are real but the subjects are not; the cake was never baked, the birthday never occurred, and the account harvesting your comfort is scheduled to be renamed 'Discount Sunglasses Outlet' within the fortnight. The Service reminds the public that compassion is a renewable resource, but not an unlimited one. Do not comment 'Amen' to disperse this front — it feeds on exactly that.

regional_outlook.conditions: Heavy sympathy-bait accumulation basinwide, with fabricated milestone imagery pooling in comment sections. Expect a 90 percent chance of a birthday nobody attended for a person who was never born.
Scattered forwarding of Delta debris as well-meaning relatives relay 'this poor man deserves recognition' chains. Filtering advised at the family level.
The same weeping cake reappears under nine hundred distinct 'wholesome quote' overlays, drifting steadily toward the boards of the unsuspecting.
Quote-tweet updraft turns pity into outrage within minutes; residents mocking the bait are, regrettably, still feeding it. Stay clear of the plume.
Calm and dry. The storm has not yet learned there is money over here, which is the only reason it is calm.

specimen.status: Abundant and expanding; peak activity near round-number ages and holidays.
specimen.habitat: Feeds in high-traffic comment currents, favoring audiences with soft hearts and fast thumbs. Nests in newly created pages that will not exist by autumn.
specimen.field_marks: A single emotionally overloaded image — the untouched cake, the lone elderly figure, the child's crayon 'masterpiece' nobody praised — paired with a caption instructing you exactly how to react. Watch for the tell-tale extra finger on the frosting and the numeric plea, '99% will scroll past.'
specimen.call: I baked this myself and nobody said happy birthday 🎂😢 — can I get just ONE like? Type Amen for a blessing.
specimen.confusion_species: Easily mistaken for a genuine post from a lonely neighbor, which is the entire mechanism. Distinguish the two by checking the account age (days), the posting history (identical cakes, different faces), and whether the page also sells solar panels. A real neighbor rarely asks you to type 'Amen' to receive a blessing on a Tuesday.

spotter_tip: If an image tells you precisely how you're supposed to feel and then instructs you to type a single word to prove it, you are not looking at a person — you are looking at a turnstile.
tomorrow: Sympathy front weakens over the Delta but reorganizes into a fabricated-graduation system by Saturday afternoon; keep your compassion metered.
